shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "--- next.config ---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "--- tsconfig ---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -20 && echo "=== cache.d.ts ===" && find node_modules/next -name "cache.d.ts" -maxdepth 3 | head && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null
grep -rn "revalidateTag\|updateTag" node_modules/next/AGENTS.md | head -40; echo "=== size ==="; wc -l node_modules/next/AGENTS.md

grep -rn "use cache\b" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js | head; echo "=== errors ==="; grep -rln "cacheComponents.*true\|To use \\\\\"use cache\\\\\"" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js node_modules/next/dist/server/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | head

cd /tmp && for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin/products | grep -o 'dateTime="[^"]*"'; done; echo "--- form markup ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin/products | grep -o '<form[^>]*>.\{0,300\}'

cd /tmp && ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin/products | grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*') && echo "action field: $ID" && echo "before: $(curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin/products | grep -o 'dateTime="[^"]*"')" && echo "--- POST (no-JS form submit) ---" && curl -s -o /tmp/post.out -w "action response: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n" -F "$ID=" http://localhost:3111/admin/products && echo "immediately after: $(curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin/products | grep -o 'dateTime="[^"]*"')" && sleep 2 && echo "2s later:          $(curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin/products | grep -o 'dateTime="[^"]*"')"
grep -iE "warn|error|deprecat" /tmp/next.log | head -10; echo "(exit $?)"; pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; echo stopped
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig/package diffs ===" && git diff --stat && git diff tsconfig.json package.json

git checkout tsconfig.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='tsconfig.json'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('".next/types/**/*.ts"]', '".next/types/**/*.ts", ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"]')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff tsconfig.json
